items.title: KLA Corp posts Q4 beat, shares tumble amid underwhelming guidance
items.summary: Investing.com -- KLA Corporation shares dropped 10% on Tuesday after the company issued guidance that fell short of expectations, even as it reported fourth-quarter results that exceeded analyst estimates.

items.title: Chip Gear Supplier KLA Tops Views, But Stock Falls After Earnings Report
items.summary: Semiconductor equipment vendor KLA beat Wall Street's targets for its fiscal Q4 and with its outlook. But KLAC stock fell.

items.title: KLA Corp forecasts upbeat quarter on sustained AI investment
items.summary: KLA Corp forecast first-quarter revenue and profit above Wall Street estimates on Tuesday, betting that continued ‌investment in AI infrastructure would sustain strong demand for ‌its chipmaking tools. Shares of the California-based company, however, fell 8% in extended trading. They have done risen over 57% so far this year.

items.title: CXMT, Sandisk, ASML, SpaceX, D-Wave Quantum, Workday, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  A chip stock slide weighed on the major indexes following reports that a state-backed Chinese company has begun mass producing chip-making machines. Those same semiconductor companies, and many artificial-intelligence names, also were under pressure Monday after Chinese memory chip maker ChangXin Memory Technologies ’(CXMT) massive trading debut.

items.title: 3 Reasons Lam Research Is Worth a Closer Look Before July 29 Q4 Earnings

items.title: Is KLA (KLAC) Undervalued Ahead Of Earnings Or Already Fully Valued?
items.summary: Earnings event puts KLA stock in focus KLA (KLAC) is set to announce quarterly earnings this Tuesday after the bell, with the market expecting 13.7% year on year revenue growth, compared with 23.6% growth in the same quarter last year. Estimates have been broadly reaffirmed over the past month, so this report will likely be read as a check on whether KLA is keeping pace with current expectations for the semiconductor equipment cycle.
